judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` while preserving `undefined` when no rounds report usage. It meets every acceptance criterion, including testing a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), leaving the existing no-tool test untouched, making the hook signature unambiguous via `totalUsage?: TotalUsageMetadata`, and updating both `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. Compared to the reference, the candidate introduces a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` (which the ticket's key files explicitly suggested) and places its new tests into two separate test files rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate updated the bullet in the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in place rather than moving it up to the main requirements list and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` like the reference did.
